verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a Tax Registrations API for adding registrations [stripe-tax-docs-18] and a general official MCP server [stripe-tax-probe-4], so an agent can programmatically reach part of the tax posture. Nexus insights [stripe-tax-docs-17] and transaction reports [stripe-tax-docs-19] are documented, but nothing shows they are exposed through the API or MCP. Filing is delegated to a TaxJar integration [stripe-tax-docs-10]. Missing for 10: API/MCP access to nexus monitoring status, an accrued-liability endpoint, visibility into upcoming filings, MCP tools specific to tax, documented scoped/restricted credentials for tax access, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven tax workflows.
